about: The only rows of this plan's runs that derive_thresholds leaves out by entry (measurement_plan.apply_exclusions verifies each claim). Rows stale for the shape need no entry: measurement_runs.supersede_stale drops them when the arm has a current-shape run of the role, and otherwise they leave the arm unmeasured.
